park_passes.summary: Your Annual Parks Canada Discovery Pass is ALREADY PURCHASED and active for this trip, so every national park stop is prepaid: Glacier NP (Rogers Pass, Hemlock Grove), Yoho NP (Natural Bridge, Emerald Lake, Takakkaw Falls), Banff NP (Lake Louise area, Bow Lake, Peyto Lake, Johnston Canyon, Icefields Parkway), Jasper NP (Columbia Icefield, Athabasca Glacier, Sunwapta Falls, Athabasca Falls, Pyramid Lake, Maligne corridor) and Mount Revelstoke NP. Display the pass at park gates. The ONLY remaining paid pass is the separate Alberta Kananaskis Conservation Pass for the Calgary / Elbow Falls day on 1 Oct and the Bragg Creek foothills. There is no shuttle reservation on this route: every lake is drive-up.

parks_canada_discovery_pass.price_note: Already purchased. No further cost. Keep the physical pass in the vehicle — there is no digital-only pass, so display it at every park gate.

hidden_gems.summary: Hand-picked hidden and off-the-beaten-path spots per stay: nature, viewpoints, shops, malls and seasonal experiences for late September to early October. Check opening status for anything seasonal before you go — fall shoulder-season hours change fast.

spots.name: Wang Shanghai soup dumplings
spots.why: Some of the best xiaolongbao in the city, tucked in the old London Drugs parking lot at 3328 Kingsway and easy to miss.
spots.tip: Go early, it fills up.

spots.name: Kingsway 3300-block food walk
spots.why: 24 restaurants and bakeries from Chinese, Filipino, Chilean and Indian communities along one block.
spots.tip: Do a small-plates crawl for lunch.

spots.name: Burnaby Village Museum
spots.why: 1912 carousel, blacksmith, historic streetcar — a step back in time.
spots.tip: Seasonal; check autumn weekend hours.

spots.name: Deer Lake Park
spots.why: Lake loop, heritage homes and Japanese garden; quiet autumn colours.
spots.tip: Combines with Metrotown.

spots.name: Vancouver Police Museum
spots.why: Former morgue turned museum of crime history and evidence — eerie but unforgettable.
spots.tip: Compact, rainy-day option.

spots.name: Lynn Canyon Park & suspension bridge
spots.why: Free alternative to Capilano, less crowded, deep rainforest and a 50 m suspension bridge.
spots.tip: North Vancouver; take the Seabus/SkyTrain combo.

spots.name: Pacific Spirit Regional Park
spots.why: Huge coastal rainforest right from your door; golden autumn trails.
spots.tip: Start early, quietest then.

spots.name: Museum of Anthropology (UBC)
spots.why: World-class Indigenous art — totem poles, carvings, great architecture.
spots.tip: Paid; check hours.

spots.name: Queen Elizabeth Park + Quarry Garden
spots.why: Vancouver's highest point, free panoramic city and mountain views.
spots.tip: Best at sunset.

spots.name: Kitsilano & Jericho beaches
spots.why: Scenic waterfront walk with mountain views and no crowds in October.
spots.tip: Pack a hot drink.

spots.name: Granville Island
spots.why: Public market, artisan studios and food stalls — a relaxed afternoon outing.
spots.tip: Go mid-afternoon to dodge the rush.

spots.name: Stanley Park Prospect Point
spots.why: Lions Gate Bridge and harbour panorama from the high lookout.
spots.tip: Drive or bus up; short walk from the lot.

spots.name: Paul Lake Provincial Park
spots.why: Mountain lake 25 minutes from town with easy lakeside trails and far fewer people.
spots.tip: Short leg-stretch on arrival.

spots.name: Kenna Cartwright Park sunset
spots.why: Kamloops' largest park with big-sky panoramic views over the valley.
spots.tip: Best just before sunset.

spots.name: BC Wildlife Park
spots.why: Black bears, wolves, elk, moose and raptors in natural enclosures.
spots.tip: Only if you have daylight to spare.

spots.name: Thompson Valley Wine Trail
spots.why: One of Canada's northernmost wine regions; harvest season in late September.
spots.tip: Sagewood or Privato for boutique tastings.

spots.name: Wapta Falls
spots.why: The widest waterfall on the Kicking Horse River (~100 m across), easy family trail 30 min from Golden.
spots.tip: Tucked in Yoho; quietest in the morning.

spots.name: Takakkaw Falls
spots.why: Canada's second-tallest waterfall at 373 m, visible from the road and thundering in the canyon.
spots.tip: Yoho; road is seasonal, verify access.

spots.name: Thompson Falls
spots.why: Under-the-radar powerful waterfall on the Blaeberry River, ~30 min from downtown and car-accessible.
spots.tip: Easy overlook, few visitors.

spots.name: Golden Skybridge
spots.why: Canada's highest suspension bridge pair over a canyon — with zipline, swing and mountain coaster.
spots.tip: Paid; check if the coaster is running in shoulder season.

spots.name: Emerald Lake & Natural Bridge at sunset
spots.why: Already on the route, but going late-day beats the midday crowds and lights Yoho's limestone cliffs gold.
spots.tip: Pair with a Field coffee stop.

spots.name: Johnson Lake
spots.why: Banff's best-kept-secret lake — calm water, forest loop, way fewer people than Lake Louise.
spots.tip: Easy flat trail, great morning.

spots.name: Vermilion Lakes
spots.why: Classic mirror-like reflections of Mount Rundle at sunrise or sunset.
spots.tip: Scenic drive from Banff Ave, no hiking needed.

spots.name: Cascade Ponds + Two Jack Lake
spots.why: Quiet picnic-style spots with big mountain views minutes from Banff.
spots.tip: Great fall-colour photography.

spots.name: Grassi Lakes (Canmore)
spots.why: Vivid turquoise lakes under limestone cliffs; short hike from Canmore.
spots.tip: Take the easy 'easy route', steep route is slippery.

spots.name: Policeman's Creek Boardwalk (Canmore)
spots.why: Elevated wetland boardwalk with Three Sisters reflections from downtown.
spots.tip: Dawn = mirror water.

spots.name: Canmore Engine Bridge
spots.why: Historic rail bridge turned pedestrian crossing; best vantage of Mount Rundle.
spots.tip: Golden-hour photo spot.

spots.name: Quarry Lake (Canmore)
spots.why: Local favourite for a calm lakeside sit and sunset.
spots.tip: Great with a picnic.

spots.name: The Ink Pots
spots.why: Secret alpine meadow with six colourful spring-fed pools, past Johnston Canyon's Upper Falls.
spots.tip: Moderate 6 km each way; larches in fall.

spots.name: Calgary downtown walk (Stephen Ave + East Village)
spots.why: Sandstone heritage blocks, the RiverWalk and Studio Bell — the compact downtown core is walkable in two to three hours.
spots.tip: Park at City Hall or the Telus Convention Centre parkade; use the +15 skywalks if it rains.

spots.name: Forgetmenot Pond
spots.why: Genuine hidden gem: a serene reflection pond with an easy loop through aspen that glows gold in autumn.
spots.tip: Free, quiet in October; needs Kananaskis pass to park.

spots.name: Elbow Falls & Elbow Valley
spots.why: Short walkway to river falls with flame-coloured fall foliage.
spots.tip: Go early, popular on weekends.

spots.name: West Bragg Creek trails
spots.why: Tens of kilometres of foothills singletrack and forest trails from the village.
spots.tip: Easy loops near the trailhead.

spots.name: Bass Pro Shops Calgary (Deerfoot Meadows, 11411 40 St SE)
spots.why: The giant outdoor megastore you found — fish aquariums, boats, hunting/fishing gear and a wildlife display; an attraction in itself.
spots.tip: About 40 min from Bragg Creek; weekday is quieter.

spots.name: MEC Calgary (830 10 Ave SW)
spots.why: Serious outdoor gear — microspikes, layering, maps — if you need anything for the mountains.
spots.tip: Also downtown: make it a coffee + walk combo.

spots.name: Bragg Creek village
spots.why: One main street of boutiques, a bakery and café culture in the foothills.
spots.tip: Try the local bakery before heading out.

bases.base: Yellowhead County / Hinton · Jasper area · 2–3 Oct (1 night)

spots.name: Hinton Beaver Boardwalk
spots.why: Canada's longest freshwater boardwalk, winding through beaver wetland.
spots.tip: Easy, flat, great for wildlife.

spots.name: Obed Lake Provincial Park
spots.why: Hidden-gem lake ~20 min from Hinton; still water and golden reeds at sunset.
spots.tip: Go about an hour before sunset.

spots.name: Pyramid Lake & Patricia Lake
spots.why: Quiet lakes with mountain backdrops; also your best dark-sky / aurora spot near Jasper.
spots.tip: Face north after midnight for aurora.

spots.name: Athabasca Falls
spots.why: Powerful canyon waterfall — open and worth the short walk.
spots.tip: On the Icefields Parkway route.

spots.name: Maligne Lake road + Medicine Lake
spots.why: The 'vanishing lake' in fall as it drains underground, then Maligne Lake and Moose Lake loop.
spots.tip: Maligne Canyon and Edith Cavell are CLOSED for 2026 — do this instead.

spots.name: Miette Hot Springs
spots.why: Remote mountain hot pools near the park's east edge.
spots.tip: Confirm early-October hours; entry after 3 pm is often cheaper.

spots.name: Giant Cedars Boardwalk
spots.why: 500 m loop through ancient inland rainforest with huge cedars — magical light.
spots.tip: Boardwalk typically closes right after Thanksgiving; check the bulletin for 2026.

spots.name: Skunk Cabbage Boardwalk
spots.why: Marsh boardwalk with muskrat and beaver activity, great for wildlife.
spots.tip: Easy and family-friendly.

spots.name: Meadows in the Sky Parkway
spots.why: 26 km paved road to Mount Revelstoke's summit meadows and viewpoints.
spots.tip: High-elevation snow likely by 4 Oct; check if the road is open.

spots.name: The Enchanted Forest + SkyTrek Adventure Park
spots.why: Whimsical forest trail with fairy-tale scenes, then tree-canopy ziplines next door on Hwy 1.
spots.tip: 32 km west of town, on the Kelowna route.

spots.name: Halfway / Halcyon / Nakusp Hot Springs
spots.why: Natural hot pools in forest settings within a short drive.
spots.tip: Best on the cold evening of 3 Oct.

spots.name: Myra Canyon Trestles
spots.why: 18 historic Kettle Valley Rail trestles and tunnels over a deep canyon — the #1 fall pick, with golden western larches.
spots.tip: Free parking at Myra or Ruth station; flat 12 km trail; larch peak is mid-late Oct.

spots.name: Knox Mountain + Paul's Tomb
spots.why: Panoramic views over Okanagan Lake and downtown from the city's signature hike, ending at a hidden beach.
spots.tip: 1 hr return; sunsets are superb.

spots.name: Crawford Falls
spots.why: Hidden canyon waterfalls in East Kelowna.
spots.tip: Use the longer safe route, not the rope descent.

spots.name: Mission Creek Greenway — salmon run
spots.why: October's free natural spectacle: kokanee salmon spawning in the creek.
spots.tip: First three weeks of October are best.

spots.name: Orchard Park Mall
spots.why: The Okanagan's largest indoor mall with 170+ stores, food court and cinema.
spots.tip: Wet-day option; Kelowna Farmers Market also here on Wed/Sat mornings.

spots.name: Wineries (Summerhill, CedarCreek, Tantalus)
spots.why: Harvest season tasting — golden vineyards, lake views.
spots.tip: Book tastings in advance in fall.

spots.name: Davison Orchards (Vernon)
spots.why: U-pick apples, pumpkins, a bakery and farm animals — classic fall outing.
spots.tip: 30 min north, on the way from Revelstoke.

closures_and_safety.summary: Verified 2026 status (Parks Canada + Alberta official sources): everything on the driving route is open for the trip dates. Two famous Jasper sights are closed for the whole 2026 season and are intentionally NOT on this route. Several seasonal items end right around your travel window, so check status before each day.

closed_2026.name: Maligne Canyon (Jasper NP)
closed_2026.detail: Parks Canada rehabilitation after the 2024 wildfire; picnic area and trail not permitted. Not on the route — the plan uses Maligne Lake Road + Medicine Lake instead.

closed_2026.name: Edith Cavell Road / Angel Glacier / Cavell Meadows (Jasper NP)
closed_2026.detail: Slope instability and landslide risk. Not on the route.

closed_2026.name: Valley of the Five Lakes trails (Jasper)
closed_2026.detail: Trails 9 and 9C closed for hazard tree removal (closed until further notice). Removed from the 3 Oct Jasper content; Pyramid Lake, Medicine Lake and Miette Hot Springs are the open substitutes.

closed_2026.name: Wabasso & Whirlpool campgrounds
closed_2026.detail: Full infrastructure rebuilds. Irrelevant — the plan uses booked private accommodation.

open_with_conditions.name: Moraine Lake + Lake Louise (not on this route)
open_with_conditions.detail: Moraine Lake Road stays closed to personal vehicles year-round and Lake Louise parking fills before sunrise, so both were removed from this plan. The Banff day uses drive-up lakes instead: Two Jack Lake, Lake Minnewanka and Vermilion Lakes — no shuttle, no reservation, no extra ticket.

open_with_conditions.name: Takakkaw Falls / Yoho Valley Road (Sep 28)
open_with_conditions.detail: Road open mid-June to mid-October, weather permitting. Parking is limited; arrive early.

open_with_conditions.name: Miette Hot Springs (Oct 3)
open_with_conditions.detail: Last operating day 2026 is Oct 12. Fall hours ~10:30 am–9 pm, last entry 30 min before close. First-come, first-served.

open_with_conditions.name: Giant Cedars Boardwalk (Oct 4)
open_with_conditions.detail: Parkway snow possible at summit in early Oct; check the trail-conditions report and bulletins before driving up.

open_with_conditions.name: Meadows in the Sky Parkway (Oct 4)
open_with_conditions.detail: Snow possible at the summit ~1,600 m elevation gain. If the summit road is closed by snow, stay low — Golden Skybridge and Giant Cedars still work.

closures_and_safety.winter_tire_rule: From 1 October, BC law REQUIRES winter tires (M+S minimum, 3PMSF mountain/snowflake recommended) on designated routes including the Sea-to-Sky (Hwy 99), Coquihalla (Hwy 5), Okanagan Connector (Hwy 97C) and the Trans-Canada through the mountain sections. The booked RAV4 is FWD — confirm winter-rated tires and a spare/puncture kit at the rental counter BEFORE leaving Vancouver. The Oct 1–5 legs fall inside this window.
closures_and_safety.driving_rule: The booked RAV4 is FWD, not AWD. If a mountain road is snowy or icy, do not continue just because it is in the itinerary — wait, reroute or shorten the day. Check DriveBC (drivebc.ca) and 511 Alberta (511.alberta.ca) before every mountain transfer.
